title: citywide.json — citywide trend, findings, bikeway mileage
description: See build_citywide() in pipeline/emit_api.py. protected_share is OPTIONAL — omitted entirely when there's no usable mileage snapshot.

trend.description: Passthrough of site/data/citywide_trend.json plus a Form A qualifier block (CC-1). additionalProperties true because this is source-data passthrough, not hand-enumerated here. `note` and `caveat` are different fields and both are required: `note` says what the series IS, `caveat` says how a month's count can be wrong. Do not merge them.

months.description: CC-4: the block on `trend` covers every item. The trailing PROVISIONAL_MONTHS items add caveat_tags of their own (claim.schema.json#/$defs/item_override) because they differ from the rest of the series; earlier items carry none.

findings.description: Each findings.json record, verbatim except map_state (UI-only, stripped). additionalProperties true — editorial fields may grow. Each record is a Form A claim: `stat` is the number, and `data_tier` + `caveat_tags` + `caveat` are its qualifier. The tag assignment is canonical and lives in one place, caveats.FINDING_CAVEAT_TAGS — a new finding gets a row there in the same PR that adds it.

bikeway_mileage.description: Passthrough of site/data/bikeway_mileage_series.json — additionalProperties true (by_category keys are facility categories, not enumerated here).

protected_share.description: OPTIONAL — omitted entirely when there's no usable latest mileage snapshot (empty series or total 0).
